g.text: Who owns what: Herdr · f · beads
• one workspace per feature with hotkey tabs:
• feature picker with agent status: working / idle
• worktree per repo, branch = feature name
comments: f is the ONLY writer
• PRs + CI from GitHub; f sync after merges
• launchd: f sync --all every 30 min for pr status
→ <leader>ps send review comments to Claude with f
• PRs as a gh stack per repo
• a span per git / gh / bd / herdr call
• f trace stats: p50 / p95, slowest runs
